text: At this time, the system has not identified any specific changes that are guaranteed to flip the current decision. That means there isn’t a single, verified action—like adjusting a particular account balance or adding a certain type of credit—that will automatically move the application into an approved category. However, you can still work on the broader factors that lenders typically view positively: keep existing credit‑card balances low, avoid taking on new debt, make all payments on time, and consider adding a small, well‑managed credit line if you have none. Over time, these habits can improve your overall credit profile and increase the chance of approval in future reviews.
